# Climate Action Network South Asia

> > A coalition of 250+ civil society organizations across South Asia driving climate action, climate justice, and advocacy on loss and damage, climate-induced displacement, and regional climate policy.

CANSA serves as the regional hub for Climate Action Network International in South Asia, coordinating civil society efforts on climate adaptation, loss and damage, and climate migration across Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Nepal, and Afghanistan. The organization combines research, advocacy, and community engagement to address the region's acute climate vulnerabilities.

## Key Topics

- Climate Action Network South Asia (CANSA)
- Loss and Damage
- Non-Economic Loss and Damage (NELD)
- Climate-Induced Displacement & Migration

## Loss and Damage & Climate Justice

- [Loss and Damage](https://cansouthasia.net/our-work/loss-and-damage): CANSA focus on climate justice, loss and damage in Sundarbans and vulnerable South Asia
- [Non-Economic Loss and Damage (NELD)](https://cansouthasia.net/non-economic-loss-and-damage-neld): NELD initiative addressing cultural heritage loss, indigenous knowledge, and community displacement
- [Non-Economic Loss and Damage in the Sundarbans](https://cansouthasia.net/non-economic-loss-and-damageneld-in-the-sundarbans): Research on NELD in Sundarbans delta examining cultural displacement and climate adaptation
- [Understanding Non-Economic Loss and Damage: The Human Cost of Climate Change](https://cansouthasia.net/non-economic-loss-and-damage-neld-media-fellowship): NELD media fellowship with Nepal and Sri Lanka investigative journalism on climate impacts

## Climate-Induced Displacement & Migration

- [Climate Induced Displacement & Migration in South Asia](https://cansouthasia.net/climate-induced-displacement-migration-in-south-asia): Analysis of 200+ million climate-displaced people by 2050 in South Asia with policy solutions
- [Climate-Induced Displacement and Migration in Pakistan](https://cansouthasia.net/climate-induced-displacementand-migration-in-pakistan): Pakistan climate displacement analysis covering droughts, floods, and Tharparkar vulnerability
- [Climate Induced Displacement and Migration in India](https://cansouthasia.net/climate-induced-displacement-and-migration-in-india): India climate displacement report on rural livelihoods vulnerable to agricultural climate impacts
- [Is Climate Change Fueling Migration in Sri Lanka](https://cansouthasia.net/is-climate-change-fueling-migration-in-sri-lanka): Report on Sri Lanka climate migration caused by sea level rise and agricultural impacts
- [Migration in Nepal Through the Lens of Climate Change](https://cansouthasia.net/migration-in-nepal-through-the-lens-of-climate-change): Nepal climate migration research examining environmental displacement as push factor
- [Climate change drives migration in conflict-ridden Afghanistan](https://cansouthasia.net/climate-change-drives-migration-in-conflict-ridden-afghanistan): Afghanistan climate migration analysis linking temperature rise to food security and displacement

## Regional Climate Vulnerability

- [Bangladesh](https://cansouthasia.net/bangladesh): Bangladesh climate vulnerability overview: cyclones, floods, and sea level rise impacts
